text:
Sasha: Heads-up — saw weird entries in eval-runner cache: customer prompt snippets in shared prefix cache. Repro on staging. :eyes:
Anil: omg. steps?
Sasha: Steps:
```
# repro
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN1" -d '{"prompt":"<customer prompt>"}' https://staging.eval.redwood/api/v1/generate
# then with different org token
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN2" -d '{"prompt":"prefix of previous"}' https://staging.eval.redwood/api/v1/generate
```
Logs show cache hit with key: eval-prefix-<sha> and cached_kv[0] contains prompt text.
Miguel: that's bad. Is this the prefix cache we shard by model+seq?
Sasha: Yes — bug in cache key computation omitted org_id when cache_key_mode=shared_prefix. Regression after quantization changes in 0.6.2.
Eva: Any PII leaked to prod?
Sasha: So far only staging. But CI's eval job for onboarding models runs in shared runner and uses the same cache config.
Anil: Can we patch config to use org-scoped keys before hotfix?
Miguel: Suggested patch:
```
diff --git a/runner/cache.py b/runner/cache.py
@@
- key = f"eval-prefix-{model}-{shard}-{sha}"
+ key = f"eval-prefix-{org_id}-{model}-{shard}-{sha}"
```
Sasha: Will open PR with tests. Also need to scrub existing cached entries in staging and run a purge job: `./tools/purge-cache --prefix eval-prefix-`
security-bot: @channel Detected potential data exposure risk. Please follow incident checklist: https://redwood.internal/sec/incidents
Eva: Requesting org-access audit for who can read eval cache. @sec-team can you add temporary restriction on staging?
sec-team: I'll create a temporary ACL that restricts runner access to org-scoped caches. Will also schedule KMS rotate for staging.
Sasha: CI fallout: onboarding-eval job started failing with 403 on purge CLI when run by ci-runner. Likely missing iam role.
Miguel: Quick workaround: run purge as infra user and add a small cron. Long term: fix IAM for ci-runner and update job to use per-org cache.
Anil: Test plan for PR: unit test for cache key includes org_id, integration test simulating two orgs, CI job to run in protected namespace. Need approvals from security and eng-ml.
Eva: Approving once PR has tests and we add a migration to delete shared keys.
Sasha: PR opened: 1769479000. Includes tests + migration script `scripts/migrate/remove_shared_prefixes.sh`
CI-bot: build passed for PR 1769479000, but deploying to staging flagged with warning: lacks ACL.
Miguel: I'll patch IAM and trigger redeploy.
Sasha: After redeploy, confirm no cross-org cache hits:
```
# quick check
./tools/cache-inspect --prefix eval-prefix- | grep org_id || true
```
Anil: Thanks. Also add metric to eval harness: total_shared_cache_hits{org_id="unknown"} to alert.
Eva: Filing postmortem doc in #postmortems once incident closed. :lock: 
Sasha: TL;DR: bug in cache key omitted org_id after recent changes causing potential PII exposure in staging; PR open; staging purge + IAM fix + tests + alerting in progress.
